name: Electricity Mix Report
purpose: Compares where each country's electricity comes from, year by year

inputs.electricity_generated_twh: Electricity the country generated that year, in terawatt-hours
inputs.coal_share_of_electricity: Percentage of the country's electricity made from coal
inputs.renewables_share_of_electricity: Percentage of the country's electricity made from renewable sources
inputs.carbon_intensity: Grams of CO2 emitted for each kilowatt-hour of electricity generated
inputs.net_imports_twh: Electricity imported minus electricity exported that year, in terawatt-hours
inputs.household_price: Average price households pay for electricity
inputs.grid_losses_twh: Electricity lost in the grid before it reaches customers, in terawatt-hours
